      by_contra hA
      obtain ⟨U, hU, hAU⟩ := hmiss hA
      obtain ⟨V, hV, hAV⟩ := hmiss hc
      obtain ⟨x, hxU, hxV⟩ :=

      have hxnotA : x ∉ A := by
        intro hxA
        have hx : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨hxA, hxU⟩
        simpa [hAU] using hx

have hexact (A : Set S) : A ∈ P ↔ Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    constructor
    · intro hA hc

    · intro hc
      by_contra hA

      obtain ⟨V, hV, hAV⟩ := hmiss hc
      obtain ⟨x, hxU, hxV⟩ :=
        Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (hPP U hU V hV)
      have hxnotA : x ∉ A := by
        intro hxA
        have hx : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨hxA, hxU⟩
        simpa [hAU] using hx
      have hxA : x ∈ A := by
        by_contra hxA
        have hx : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := ⟨by simpa, hxV⟩
        simpa [hAV] using hx
      exact hxnotA hxA
